rules.label: N64 layout 1: the core's layout, with the dead face buttons on C-down and C-left
rules.notes: Mupen64Plus-Next's default layout only reads the east and north face buttons while R2 is held (the C-button chord), so on their own they do nothing (custom/mupen64plus-core/plugin/emulate_game_controller_via_libretro.c L351-368 @ mupen64plus-libretro-nx 12edd2c). This puts C-down and C-left on them. The right stick still gives all four C buttons, and R2 + face buttons still work.

rules.label: N64 layout 2: face buttons are the C buttons, A and B on the bumpers
rules.notes: For C-heavy games (Ocarina's items and songs, Star Fox). Z stays on L2 and the right stick still gives the C buttons. N64 L moves to Select, which is also EmuDeck's hotkey-enable button [VERIFY] that Select still reaches the core.

rules.label: N64 layout 3: the core's 'independent C buttons' scheme, as a remap
rules.notes: The same buttons as the core option mupen64plus-alt-map=True (emulate_game_controller_via_libretro.c L339-349 @ 12edd2c), done as a remap so the core option can stay at its default. A on the bottom, B on the left, Z on L2 as before.
